caption: The drawing features a rectangular grid pattern composed of small squares and rectangles, arranged in a checkered layout. The grid is made up of intersecting horizontal and vertical lines, which are primarily dark blue in color. Within various squares, dark blue, roughly elliptical shapes or brushstrokes are present, adding texture and visual variation. The background is off-white or light beige, and the grid lines and shaded areas are mostly concentrated in blue tonalities. The composition has an even, repetitive structure with some slight irregularities in line thickness and spacing. Below the grid pattern, on the lower right corner, appears handwritten text in black ink that reads "Lon Cronk."
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
